verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is explicitly a terminal-based coding agent with rich first-party docs (querying/editing codebases, debugging, non-interactive scripting, context files, MCP integration) and extensive hands-on community usage confirming it runs and operates directly from the terminal on real codebases. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of terminal performance/UX polish and resolution of reliability complaints that affect overall trust though not the core local-run capability.
